change_log: 4.0.1: Gate completed identical replay routing through SEAT proof-possession actions and retain full verification for effectful checkout/finalization.

change_log.summary: Add ND-195 anchor gates for payment_intent_id attribute + finalize output + invariant; update contract_ref to 3.6.0.
Update contract_ref to v3.7.0; update GC-001 chain pin for SEAT-1; add gates for DP-1 bulkhead routing + physics_layer pins.
Phase-5 hardening: update physics_layer EVT-1 pin to 2.16.4; add dependency_floors parity gate for EVT-1/EVT-2/REFUND-1/LED-1/PAY-3; update contract_ref to v3.7.2.
Fix artifact_name/version parity in contract and gates; pin gate self-identity to 3.7.3.
GAP-2.1 enforcement: extend dependency_floors pin gate to require API-0@1.1.1 and PSC-1@1.8.2.

gates.description: Bundle declares the correct suite schema.
Bundle uses the standard manifest filename.
Bundle files match manifest (paths, hashes, bytes).
Identity: contract doc_id + version match this gate pack.
finalize_checkout MUST accept only the server-owned input whitelist (client cannot inject fees).
GC-001 / SD-043 controls are explicitly declared (stable pointers).
GC-001 / SD-043 invariants are present at canonical positions (no silent drift).

acceptance_criteria: ORD-1 contract pins GC-001 chain versions in dependency_pins.gc_001_chain.
Pinned versions match the issued bundles in this hardening sequence (ERR/SEAT/PAY-1/2/3/OBS/PRICE/TEN).
gates.description: GC-001 dependency pins MUST match the patched chain versions to prevent drift.
negative_tests: If dependency_pins.gc_001_chain is missing or pins a different version, CI MUST fail.
If TEN-1 or PRICE-1 pins drift from suite actives, CI MUST fail.

gates.description: War-time: DP-1 bulkhead routing MUST be declared for checkout vs expiry workloads (stable pointers).
War-time: ORD-1 pins Physics Layer dependencies (DP-1/LOCKS-1/SM-0/EVT-1).
No placeholders or TODO markers in core artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Contract, test gates, and manifest MUST NOT ship unresolved placeholder markers in governed artifact content.
Pre-release review MUST confirm no TODO, TBD, FIXME, or REPLACE_ME tokens remain in published artifact bodies.

gates.description: Order carries the immutable TAXCTX-V2 quote value provenance and opaque PII evidence reference and digest.
Hardening: internal rounding adjustment required for balanced totals (ND-172).
Hardening: finalized_at_utc must be DB-sourced temporal truth (ND-170).
ND-195: Order model must include payment_intent_id attribute (nullable until finalization).
ND-195: finalize_checkout output_minimum must include payment_intent_id so downstream can journal and observe.
ND-195: contract must declare payment anchor invariant.
Outbox required_data_keys/required_keys MUST NOT include envelope headers (org_id, trace_id, request_id, registry_version_sha).
Outbox schema_ref MUST be normalized to EVT-2 for all ORD-1 outbox events.
Phase-5 + GAP-2: dependency_floors MUST pin registry heads and runtime survival law floors (API-0/PSC-1) to prevent drift.
ORD-1 MUST hard-pin API-0 contract artifact sha256.
ORD-1 MUST hard-pin PSC-1 contract artifact sha256.
ORD-1 MUST hard-pin PROD-1 contract artifact sha256.
ORD-1 MUST declare the Redis↔Postgres handover invariant to prevent ghost holds.

details.equals: Copy tax_profile_id, applicable_tax_rate_revision_refs, tax_pricing_mode, evaluated_at_utc, tax_context_digest_version, tax_context_digest_sha256, opaque_pii_jurisdiction_evidence_ref, and jurisdiction_evidence_sha256 from the frozen signed PRICE-1 snapshot. PRICE-1 binds tax_context_digest_version/hash one-to-one to TAXCTX-V2 digest_version/hash. Do not add tax_context_id, a TaxContext resource, or alternate field names. TAX-1 governs any separate tax-point determination; ORD does not map that determination onto evaluated_at_utc.

create_checkout canonical request hash and replay proof validation
gates.description: ORD-1 uses the LOCKS-1 durable identity and hashes only the canonical normalized effect-bearing create_checkout request. Completed replays still authenticate actor context and validate proof signatures without rechecking mutable hold state.
gates.failure_message: create_checkout request-hash or replay-proof semantics drifted from the approved T0 lock.

details.criterion: The request hash uses SHA-256 over UTF-8 RFC8785 JCS of the approved normalized fields, excludes correlation/idempotency metadata and signatures, normalizes unordered proof lists, and validates proof possession before replay without checking mutable hold state.

acceptance_criteria: Identical canonical requests produce the same request_hash regardless of request_id, trace_id, or proof-array order.
Changes to the exact pricing_snapshot_id, authenticated actor, proof hold identity, or entitlement allocation change the request_hash.
A completed replay re-authenticates actor context and cryptographically validates supplied proof signatures but does not re-evaluate mutable hold status, expiry, or quantity.
